About this pack

This pack prepares an account manager for a licensing conversation. It is not for clients: it names people and includes internal checks. Send clients the report built from the Microsoft 365 Licensing Review template instead.

Figures come from CIPP's most recent data collection for the tenant, which normally runs nightly, not from the moment the pack was generated. For costed savings based on how people actually use their licences, open the Licence Report in CIPP (Tenant Administration, Reports), go to the Optimization tab and download its PDF.
